# Aman Bohra — Analytics & Business Intelligence Leader

> Aman Bohra is an Analytics & Business Intelligence leader with 9+ years of experience across insurance, banking, retail, automotive, pharma and manufacturing, currently International Module Lead on a major US Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance analytics engagement at LTIMindtree. Analytics is his core craft and insurance is where he has proven it deepest. He specializes in Business Intelligence, analytics delivery leadership, cross-industry analytics, data engineering, and translating data science and Generative AI into business decisions. Tools: Qlik Sense, QlikView, Qlik NPrinting, Power BI, Databricks, Apache Spark, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, and RAG/GenAI. He holds 12 professional certifications (6 Databricks, Microsoft PL-300, 4 Qlik, HackerRank SQL) and an M.Tech in Data Science & Engineering from BITS Pilani.
